feeds.title: Autism Awareness Centre News
feeds.description: Maureen's blog is about current events, resources, and a variety of relevant topics about Autism & Autism Spectrum Disorder (formerly Asperger's). Maureen Bennie created the Autism Awareness Centre in 2003 to address what she saw as a gap in support, information, resources and advocacy for those struggling with autism spectrum disorders.

feeds.title: Kerry's Place
feeds.description: We are Canada's largest service provider to families with children, adolescents, and adults, with Autism Spectrum Disorder. We encourage them to pursue their own personal goals including outings into the community, employment, athletics, and a varied array of hobbies and interests.

feeds.title: Woodview Mental Health & Autism Services Blog
feeds.description: Woodview offers services and support for children and youth facing mental health challenges and for those diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD).

feeds.title: Integrated Autism Consulting Blog
feeds.description: Integrated Autism Consulting provides skilled, evidence and solution-based services for individuals, families, and professionals across the lifespan and the spectrum.

feeds.title: QuickStart Autism Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to assist children in reaching their full potential by helping the children obtain early intervention at the first signs of autism. QuickStart raises awareness and initiates programs to cut wait times, build capacity, and promote improvements in early identification and intervention. We believe there need to be equitable services throughout Canada.

feeds.title: Canucks Autism Network Blog
feeds.description: Read about the successes and stories that characterize our programs and initiatives on a daily basis. Canucks Autism Network (CAN) was founded in 2008 by Vancouver Canucks Co-owners, Paolo and Clara Aquilini, whose son has autism. CAN is dedicated to providing programs to individuals on the autism spectrum and their families while promoting acceptance and inclusion through community engagement and training initiatives across BC and beyond.

feeds.title: A4A Ontario
feeds.description: Autistics 4 Autistics (A4A) is a collective of autistic adults engaged in community education, events, activism, and advocating for reform to Canadian autism policy. We are proudly autistic and united in supporting all autistics in the province on the issues that impact our community.

feeds.title: Autism Services of Saskatoon
feeds.description: Autism Services is a Saskatoon-based, charitable organization dedicated to providing advocacy, support, education, recreational, and social, and residential programs and services to individuals with autism spectrum disorder and their families.

feeds.title: Side by Side Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Side by Side Therapy offers behaviour analytic services to children with Autism Spectrum Disorder and other special needs.

feeds.title: Orbital Learning Inc Blog
feeds.description: Orbital Learning Inc's vision is to normalize neurodiversity in the workplace. Our specialty is the employment and retention of individuals on the autism spectrum in business or professional roles. Our track record in placing individuals on the autism spectrum in well-paying jobs and helping organizations to neurodiversity is excellent. We have the experience and resources to provide the training and support you need to succeed.

feeds.title: Autism Calgary Blog
feeds.description: Autism Calgary is an association of individuals and families living with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) striving to assist each other and the broader community so that those with ASD live meaningful and purposeful lives. Its mission is to bring hope and help meet the needs of families and individuals living with Autism Spectrum Disorder.

feeds.title: Autism Self Advocacy Services
feeds.description: Founded by Todd Simkover, Autism Self-Advocacy Services provides resources to assist individuals on the autism spectrum and/or their families, obtaining the tools required to develop self-empowerment. Todd Simkover has an M.A. in Critical Disability Studies from York University in Toronto. Driven by his own lived experiences on the autism spectrum, he understands first-hand what life challenges are.

feeds.title: Embrace Autism Blog
feeds.description: The Embrace Autism blog is an information portal of research & experience-based autism content for personal elucidation and empowerment. Dissatisfied with the lack of information available on autism in adults, in 2018 we founded Embrace Autism which we intended as a platform to distribute research and experience-based information on autism.

feeds.title: Autistics United Canada Blog
feeds.description: Autistics United (AU) Canada is a grassroots advocacy organization by and for Autistic people in what is colonially known as Canada. AU Canada has worked hard to promote the inclusion of Autistic people in the conversations and decisions that affect our lives. All our leadership positions are held by Autistic people, reflecting our core value: 'Nothing About Us, Without Us!'

feeds.title: AutismBC Blog
feeds.description: We empower, support, and connect the autism community in BC. AutismBC is a small, non-profit, and registered charity that encourages the inclusion and acceptance of the entire autism community. Our mission is to promote understanding, acceptance, and full community inclusion for people with autism in British Columbia while providing support for the realization of the rights and informed choices of individuals with autism and their families.
